newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, ASK S.AFRICA TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, ASK S.AFRICA TO BAT.

text.p: Australia won the toss in the second test at St George's Park on Friday, and asked South Africa to bat.
The Australian team was unchanged from the first test while South Africa included Herschelle Gibbs as an extra batsman in place of all-rounder Lance Klusener.
South Africa: Gary Kirsten, Adam Bacher, Jacques Kallis, Daryll Cullinan, Hansie Cronje (captain), Herschelle Gibbs, Brian McMillan, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Allan Donald, Paul Adams.
Australia: Matthew Hayden, Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Elliott, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Jason Gillespie, Glenn McGrath.
